method: Verify the 1.23b version and decimal master-to-definition reference; follow every locale block's explicit data, enable and offset resource; derive typed field mappings from each definition and the merged CSV header; compare every supplied field, retain opaque string framing for finite anchors, and hash ordered row keys and row spans.

nativeBoundary.statement: This report authenticates the named xtx/attributive definition and its backing rows against the merged CSV. It assigns no runtime token, selection, grammar or rendering behavior.
